turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Dev. Good to hear from you today. How are things going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Honestly, not that great today. I got some news yesterday afternoon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, Tarnwell sent a rejection email after that technical screen I did. They aren't moving forward with me.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Ah, Dev. That stings after all the work you put in. How are you taking the news?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's been really discouraging, to be honest. I was sitting on the couch last night just wondering if walking away from teaching was a huge mistake.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A rejection makes the whole leap feel heavy. What part of you is second-guessing the move?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I guess just comfort and certainty. In the classroom, I knew the routine, and out here I'm getting turned down after writing queries under pressure.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Seven years of comfort is hard to walk away from. You left because you wanted to solve bigger problems with data. Does that still pull at you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It does, yeah. When I'm actually working on SQL problems or building something, I love it. It's just the rejection part that feels brutal.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Job searches test everyone that way. Did Tarnwell give you any specific notes on the coding round?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nope. Just the boilerplate form letter saying they had a competitive pool. It leaves you guessing.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Those generic notes give you nothing to build on. Do you want to take a breather this weekend, or would looking at a practice problem help?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No coding this weekend, I think. A couple days away from the screen will probably clear my head.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Stepping back is a wise move. Can you do something completely unrelated to the job hunt tomorrow?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, definitely. I might go for a long hike and catch up with a friend. Thanks for listening, Wren.
